rows.title: Fresh final child input boundary
rows.requirement: The one fresh final child receives only complete exact packet, acceptance matrix, verification evidence, and the versioned read-only review profile.

rows.title: Blocker revokes clean state
rows.requirement: A blocker or high result creates no clean receipt and revokes any current clean state.

rows.title: Complete same-child correction rebinding
rows.requirement: Every correction resumes the same child against a newly frozen complete input set bound to the new exact head.

rows.title: Correction and failure cap
rows.requirement: At most two resumes are accepted; a third correction, child loss, timeout, provider failure, or malformed receipt remains blocked.

rows.title: Same-head blocker revocation
rows.requirement: A later authenticated Terra blocker revokes a clean receipt even when the exact HEAD is unchanged.

rows.title: Exact lineage and input binding
rows.requirement: Wrong child lineage, model, profile, repository, PR, base/head, packet, matrix, evidence, nonce, or revoked receipt fails closed.

rows.title: Minimal public provenance
rows.requirement: Published v3 markers reject identity, session/run, transcript, finding text, path, usage, token, latency, and cost material.

rows.title: Bounded caller provenance
rows.requirement: Model and profile fields are bounded maintainer-attested caller claims and are not external proof of model execution.

rows.title: V2 legacy downgrade protection
rows.requirement: Historical v2 markers remain frozen packet-consistency evidence and cannot satisfy the v3 final-review gate.

rows.title: Trusted bootstrap workflow
rows.requirement: The trusted workflow validates v3 from immutable base code with read-only permissions, bounded inputs, and no candidate dependency execution.

rows.title: Activation after bootstrap
rows.requirement: A bootstrap PR is not required to enforce its own new validator; v3 activation succeeds only after the validator is present on the trusted base.
